title: Chapter 36
text: ∫ In the morning we awakened, man and wife, as so many people do. But there was a new cat, a 5th cat, a very young fellow who had entered our family that night. He was terrorized by life, hungry, lonely. Somehow in our drunkenness, we had fed him. Now, down on the rug, he whirled about, leaped in joy and in some panic of the newness of things, he looked at us with his wild yellow eyes. A good sign: a new life, like ours. Then I thought, today Linda Lee will eat something besides that cheesecake wedding cake (the remainder of which was jammed into the refrigerator). And someday we will see all those many wedding photos and we will live it all over again and ingest, once again, the crazy magic. “Good morning, Mrs. Bukowski,” I said, rather laughing. “Good morning, dear husband,” Linda Lee answered, rather laughing back. And we had this new door in the side of our house. And many more doors to open.
